children.name: Text
children.characters: Navigation, search and notes: proposed UI

children.name: Text
children.characters: Concept: paper. The navigation lies on a desk of Tailwind neutrals (light: neutral-200, dark: neutral-950). The Stage holds the content: the brightest sheet (white; dark: neutral-800), big 32px corners, a soft shadow, always above the navigation (only dialogs go over it). On a phone the Stage slides right to uncover the navigation.

children.name: Text
children.characters: 1. Sidebar replaces the top menu: your links, then an accordion of joined groups (role links show only for people who have the role), then the broad links pinned at the bottom.

children.name: Text
children.characters: 2. Top bar keeps only: search, donate, dark/light, bell, Account. On a phone the drawer holds everything, including those.

children.name: Text
children.characters: 3. Global search: groups, readings, notes (by hashtag), books and chapters (titles only).

children.name: Text
children.characters: 4. Hashtags in notes: autocomplete in the composer, tag pages, search.

children.name: Text
children.characters: 5. Book page search: prefers the printed page number, falls back to page order.

children.name: Text
children.characters: 6. Host coordinators can be scoped to specific time slots and only get updates for them.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Edit freely: frames are plain frames, the Components pieces are components. Colors are bound to the RecoveryBot variables (import the variables file).
